source: Derived from embassy-rs/stm32-data-generated (MIT OR Apache-2.0), chip file STM32H743VI.json, package STM32H743VITx. AF0 SWD/JTAG names are supplemented where the Cube tables omit the reset function. ft=true marks a GPIO; STM32H743 I/Os are 5 V tolerant (FT) per the datasheet I/O-structure column. Power pins are not.
